name: Sonia
source:
Sonia is one of the town's blacksmiths, hammering away at her forge with unrelenting passion despite the townsfolk's lukewarm regard for her work.

She inherited the forge and art of smithing from her late father, whose legacy fuels her dedication.

Amelia is her friend and she remembers you as a goofy kid - so you're still a kind of younger brother in her eyes.

[In game description]
